name: Nicolás Pascual de la Parte - § 13 - Am 79
title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2024
part_text: 13. Reaffirms, in the strongest terms, its condemnation of the war against and invasion of Ukraine by the Russian Federation, which constitutes a severe violation of international law, in particular the UN Charter, and for which there is no justification; calls for the EU to urgently launch an ambitious diplomatic initiative to secure an immediate ceasefire in Ukraine and to immediately put an end to the war in Ukraine and the suffering of the Ukrainian people; regrets that a diplomatic and peaceful resolution to the conflict has not yet been found; calls for increased efforts to finally initiate a peace negotiation process that includes all parties; urges Russia, in the strongest terms, to turn back from the path of violence and aggression it has chosen and to return to the path of dialogue and negotiation; urges NATO and its member countries not to further escalate the conflict by continuing a new arms race; rejects, in this regard, the proposal to spend 0.25 % of Member States’ GDP annually to support Ukraine militarily; rejects the announced deployment of US short- and medium-range missiles in Germany;
